operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) There is established the Presidential Commission on the Space Shuttle Challenger Accident. The Commission shall be composed of not more than 20 members appointed or designated by the President. The members shall be drawn from among distinguished leaders of the government, and the scientific, technical, and management communities.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 1(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The President shall designate a Chairman and a Vice Chairman from among the members of the Commission.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 1(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The Commission shall investigate the accident to the Space Shuttle Challenger, which occurred on January 28, 1986.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 2(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
(b) The Commission shall:

(1) Review the circumstances surrounding the accident to establish the probable cause or causes of the accident; and

(2) Develop recommendations for corrective or other action based upon the Commission's findings and determinations.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 2(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) The Commission shall submit its final report to the President and the Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration within one hundred and twenty days of the date of this Order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 2(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The heads of Executive departments and agencies shall, to the extent permitted by law, provide the Commission with such information as it may require for purposes of carrying out its functions.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 3(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) Members of the Commission shall serve without compensation for their work on the Commission. However, members appointed from among private citizens of the United States may be allowed travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, to the extent permitted by law for persons serving intermittently in the government service (5 U.S.C. 5701-5707).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 3(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) To the extent permitted by law, and subject to the availability of appropriations, the Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration shall provide the Commission with such administrative services, funds, facilities, staff, and other support services as may be necessary for the performance of its functions.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 3(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Notwithstanding the provisions of any other Executive Order, the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act which are applicable to the Commission, except that of reporting annually to the Congress, shall be performed by the Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, in accordance with guidelines and procedures established by the Administrator of General Services.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 254964; common-crawl capture 2025-09-11T17:54:59Z; Sec. 4(a)
